allocation.scope: Recoveries related to defined Third Party Claims; no actual allocations calculated.

findings.title: Guarantee and legal fees
findings.text: Section 1.3.6: the City guarantees WRCOG recovery of $7 million from Third Party Claims, plus a fee share equal to the lesser of 50% of legal fees incurred pursuing those claims or $1 million. WRCOG advances that fee share; reimbursement forms part of the Litigation Guaranty.

findings.title: Conditional repayment
findings.text: If recoveries had not reached $8 million by July 1, 2022, the text provides for annual payments beginning August 1, 2022 over 20 years, adjusted for subsequent recoveries. This records a conditional provision, not a finding that payments became due or were made. Section 1.3.7 addresses indemnity and the guarantee cap.

findings.title: Claims and assignment
findings.text: Defined Third Party Claims include certain restitution claims as well as other claims. Assignment is upon written request from WRCOG; the packet does not establish that every criminal restitution payment was credited under this provision.

findings.title: Other obligations remain separate
findings.text: The text separately addresses Measure A revenue sharing capped at $9.4 million, including an $8 million recovery condition; a $2 million payment to WRCOG; $2.1 million for Cherry Valley Boulevard/I-10 design; a $3 million designated Pennsylvania Avenue account; and transportation improvements. These obligations are not recovery receipts.

findings.title: Judgment recital is not the later balance
findings.text: The recitals state $42,994,879 principal, $14,809,096 prejudgment interest, and $2,077,525 fees/costs, totaling $59,881,500, with further interest described at $8,246 per day. This does not by itself verify the later approximately $62 million figure.

findings.title: Release language and execution
findings.text: Section 2 contains releases with exceptions for Third Party Claims. The agreement states effectiveness requires full execution and governing-body approval; signature lines in this approval copy are blank. Actual execution and court dismissal require further records.

findings.title: Original April agreement and May amendment
findings.text: The April approval copy names the City and WRCOG and contains the same recovery brackets and guarantee in the reviewed clauses. The May staff report describes adding City-related entities and assignment upon WRCOG written request. The April packet also supplies Exhibits 1–6, inventoried but not fully analyzed. Both packet copies have blank signature lines; this is a limited comparison, not verification of execution.
